title: Boeing's MAX 10 Finally Certified, United Has a Scary Moment Over Nevada, and Southwest Flirts With Going Widebody
summary: Boeing finally gets the MAX 10 certified after years in FAA purgatory — we break down why this one actually matters. Plus, a United flight from Vegas to Newark turns back over a hijacking text, Southwest inches closer to buying its first-ever widebody jet, and American and United both just bought their way onto Azul's board.
